fact: SimoCash, an app launched in May 2026, is said to carry instant cross-border transfers across Cote d'Ivoire, Senegal, Mali, Togo, Burkina Faso and Benin.
The BCEAO says the Treasury of Cote d'Ivoire makes regular bulk payments through the WAEMU regional PI-SPI platform.
Fraternite Matin reports the BCEAO launched the regional PI-SPI instant payment platform on 30 September 2025 for all UEMOA institutions, with 80 connected.

The Africa Report says the BCEAO pilot of an interoperable instant payment system covering all eight WAEMU states, including Cote d'Ivoire, began in early August 2024, intended to allow cross-border transactions across the zone.
